steps.title: Establish App Meta-Configuration
steps.description: Establish the application meta descriptor containing app name 'Voice Control Assistant' and package identifier 'com.voicecontrolassistant.app'.

steps.title: Configure Accessibility Service Rules
steps.description: Ensure configurations are set for retrieval of interactive window contents and view resource IDs.

steps.title: Initialize Continuous Speech Recognizer Engine
steps.description: Create background speech recognition services with explicit continuous listening modes and a 10-minute session limit.

steps.title: Initialize TextToSpeech Engine safely
steps.description: Initialize Android's native TextToSpeech engine on start-up with error checking to prevent application crashes when engine is unavailable.

steps.title: Implement Utterance Coordination and Mute Control
steps.description: Develop strict mutual exclusion routines to temporarily pause SpeechRecognizer when TextToSpeech is speaking to avoid voice echo feedback loops.

steps.title: Implement Greeting and Conversational Parser
steps.description: Add parsing for English and Hinglish conversational phrases and direct assistant responses without starting application actions.

steps.title: Implement Multi-Step Voice Command Tokenizer
steps.description: Improve command tokenizer to correctly isolate natural language multi-action chains with separators like 'and', 'then', or 'phir' without breaking search queries.

steps.title: Build Context-Aware Sentence Action Classifier
steps.description: Parse voice commands into structured sequence actions matching OPEN, SEARCH, CLICK, TYPE, SCROLL_DOWN, SCROLL_UP, PLAY, BACK, HOME, SUBMIT, and Hinglish variants.

steps.title: Design Dynamic Sequential Execution Engine
steps.description: Develop ActionExecutor mechanism to process commands sequentially with layout refresh state checks, context awareness, and verification delays.

steps.title: Formulate Heuristic Search Pipeline Clicking & Submission
steps.description: Optimize list/recyclerview programmatic search element detection, input injection, and automated submit action invocation.

steps.title: Implement Auto-Verifiable Interactive Click Engine
steps.description: Develop recursive traverser to click targets or parents, refreshing screen content hash to verify visual transitions.

steps.title: Create Non-Coordinate Programmatic Scroller State Evaluator
steps.description: Determine programmatically scrollable containers like ViewPager or RecyclerView, compare state differences, and evaluate scroll completion.

steps.title: Write Dynamic Content and Play Button Detector
steps.description: Identify eligible playlist items, video title cards, and play controls on external apps using non-coordinate heuristic layout scanners.

steps.title: Implement Automatic Flow Retry and Crash-Resistant Fallbacks
steps.description: Incorporate single-action failure handlers, stop-cascade parameters, retry timeouts, and graceful UI notification fallbacks.

steps.title: Building Voice Control Assistant
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and build the updated Voice Control Assistant using Gradle command line utilities.
